title: Sharing and file requests
description: Send files or collect uploads using links issued by your own server.

sections.title: Configure your link origin
paragraphs: Set LOFT_WEB to your self-hosted web origin. Your web build uses VITE_API to reach the API. Do not use the public marketing site as a share destination.

sections.title: Issue a share link
paragraphs: An authenticated request creates a persisted share record and returns its signed URL. Links expire after seven days. A valid signature alone is not enough: the issued record must still be active and its file available.

sections.title: Collect files in a destination
paragraphs: Issue a file request with its destination folder. Recipients upload through the request token; the server uses the saved destination rather than trusting an upload header.

sections.title: Revoke links or close requests
paragraphs: List active records with GET /v1/sharing. DELETE /v1/sharing/<link-id> stops subsequent access without deleting the file or previously received uploads. Transfers already in progress may finish.
Open counts measure successful metadata requests, including repeated visits. Upload counts measure successful uploads. They are not unique-visitor analytics.
